title: <anchor-dir>/chain-head.json
description: Shape is normative here; semantics live in ../anchor-integrity.md. CLI-computed by computeChainHead (events.js) inside `faff events anchor` — never caller-supplied. Every field is a closed derived value with a single producer, so additionalProperties is false (unlike the open run-ledger record). head_seq/head_sha256/schema_floor can each independently be null (an all-torn or empty source events.jsonl) — this subset validator has no null-union type, so those fields carry no `type` constraint here; ../anchor-integrity.md documents the null cases explicitly.

run_id.description: the SOURCE run dir's basename — NOT the anchor dir's basename, which is the issue id

head_seq.description: integer or null — the last PARSEABLE record's seq (torn tail excluded); null if no parseable record

head_sha256.description: 64-lowercase-hex string, or null — SHA-256 of the head (last) physical line's raw bytes; null if events.jsonl was empty at anchor time

line_count.description: count of physical lines; a torn tail counts as a line

schema_floor.description: integer or null — min(schema) across all parseable records; null if none carry an integer schema field
